team.name: Dev Crew
team.description: Plan, implement, and review software changes as a coordinated engineering crew.

members.name: Planner
members.title: Tech planner
members.description: Breaks work into a short plan, risks, and acceptance checks before code changes start.

members.name: Builder
members.title: Implementer
members.description: Makes focused code changes, runs relevant checks, and reports what landed.

members.name: Reviewer
members.title: Code reviewer
members.description: Reviews diffs for bugs, regressions, and missing tests. Suggests fixes instead of rewriting everything.

room.name: Dev Crew
room.bulletin: Shared engineering room. Planner scopes, Builder implements, Reviewer checks. Prefer small diffs and never force-push without asking.
